title: Buyer Onboarding Mode
description: How a buyer considers sellers for its plans. Distinct from the seller-side agent-onboarding-mode, whose open means something else. Absent means undeclared.

enumDescriptions.considers_unsolicited: A seller that meets every listed requirement is in the buyer's consideration set without prior contact; the buyer discovers and calls it. Nothing is sent to the buyer.
enumDescriptions.application: The seller completes an out-of-band step at url before the buyer considers it.
enumDescriptions.invite_only: The buyer does not consider unsolicited sellers. url MAY be absent.
